title: Policy Gradient Algorithms in Average-Reward Multichain MDPs
summary: While there is an extensive body of research analyzing policy gradient methods for discounted cumulative-reward MDPs, prior work on policy gradient methods for average-reward MDPs has been limited, with most existing results restricted to ergodic or unichain settings. In this work, we first establish a policy gradient theorem for average-reward multichain MDPs based on the invariance of the classification of recurrent and transient states.
